reason: The hypothesis directly transfers a mechanism reported in P3 (dislocation climb in HEA coating promotes twin formation in the substrate) to the coating itself, and links it to wear resistance, but this transfer is not justified and the core idea is essentially a restatement of the finding in P3 and the composition-dependent twinning reported in P19 and P13, with only a change in the target property from strength to wear.
